data.body: /dso:fix-bug BASIC investigation: confirmed root cause per ticket comment — region-split fallback fragments cross-file diff context into per-directory clusters; arch-synthesis does not reconcile 'missing consumer' findings across sibling clusters. Classification: COMPLEX. Fix requires (1) cross-cluster consensus check in arch-synthesis before emitting 'missing X' findings, (2) context-augmentation on cross-file 'missing' claims, (3) cluster boundary metadata in specialist prompts, (4) defense lookup by description-hash. Multi-subsystem: region_split.py, runner.py, arch-synthesis agent. Not suitable for single-bug fix-bug pass; recommend /dso:brainstorm seed. Leaving OPEN.
